svg.title: Meteorologist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as meteorologist, wearing a raincoat. Visible work cue: Three open cup-shaped anemometer heads connect to a central rotor above a slim instrument mast. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face.
